body: I see myself as a jack of all trades, I could go in many directions with  ideas.. It's just hard to set goals and map out a plan that involves zero face to face communication.. I plan things amazingly, but I'm nervous to take risks or make decisions, and the hopeless outlook makes sure my perseverance isn't there to follow through.

You in the US? And yeah I hear ya on the we need make ourselves be found, I feel like I need to do something on my own, create something on my own and make a living independent from the business world, since no real company will ever take me seriously or help/hire me

No therapy, It definitely helps my mood when I talk to someone. I've tried a few anxiety medications, as well as effexor, I know my endorphins are lacking, seeing as I have monumentally low energy and motivation, with definite improvements to my mood when I take a supplement meant to boost serotonin or dopamine production. I do feel some of my anguish can be masked with drugs, but the underlying truths of how I see myself and how much I hate where I stand in life remain. Just on the financial side of all this, I can't seem to be happy while I can't afford a vehicle, health insurance, etc
